metadata.description:
The German side of the Petersburger Wörterbuch edition graph, serialized for FAIR reuse as OntoLex-Lemon (Turtle) and TEI Lex-0 (XML).

459 lexical entries / 11581 edition senses drawn from five editions (nws, pw, pwg, pwkvn, sch). Each sense carries machine-derived structural layers computed from the German string: government (2125), citation edges (40700), edition relations (6008), form notes (42), non-German gloss spans (86).

This dataset contains no translation, no review score and no evidence grade. A hard field allowlist and a post-serialization byte fence exclude the project's Russian translation store from the export.

Source editions PWG (1855–1875), PW (1879–1889), SCH (1928) and PWKVN are in the public domain. The NWS layer (432 senses) is the Cologne Nachtragswörterbuch working layer. The derived structure is the authors' own work, released CC-BY-SA-4.0. See DATASHEET.md in the deposit.
metadata.title: PWG DE edition graph — OntoLex-Lemon + TEI Lex-0 sidecars
